audit_rules: Deterministic audit of one page, in canonical order: missing_title (title NULL/empty), missing_meta (meta_description NULL/empty), missing_h1 (h1 NULL/empty), thin_content (word_count < 300), slow_template (load_ms > 2500). app.py's audit endpoint states them; checks.py recomputes them independently from raw page fields and compares.
note: Job templates the Manager can post for the SEO department. Shape mirrors orchestrator/engine.py JOB_FAMILIES (key, title, brief, budget_credits, acceptance_criteria). Each template's check is deterministic and implemented in checks.py; the Reviewer runs the check by re-reading SEODash state through the tool layer — no LLM judgement. The department's surface is analysis and drafts only: reports, briefs and plans are records; nothing publishes or edits a live page.
orphan_rule: A page is an orphan iff it is not the root page ('/') and no existing internal link points at it.

acceptance_criteria: An audit report is saved covering exactly the site's landing pages
The report's findings for every page exactly match the deterministic audit rules recomputed from live page data (missing title/meta/H1, thin content under 300 words, slow template over 2500 ms)
templates.brief: Run the deterministic on-page audit over every landing page of the site and save one audit report (scope 'landing_pages') recording each page's issues exactly as the audit rules derive them.
templates.title: Audit the top landing pages

acceptance_criteria: A content brief is saved for the keyword 'best trail running shoes for monsoon'
The brief's intent matches the seeded keyword record and the brief is tied to that keyword
The brief outline has at least 4 sections, uses at least 2 seeded competitor angles, and at least 2 outline sections reference a seeded competitor angle
templates.brief: Write a content brief for the tracked keyword 'best trail running shoes for monsoon': read the keyword's record (intent, volume, seeded competitor angles), draft a brief whose outline has at least 4 sections drawing on the seeded competitor angles, save it, and point the keyword at the trail-running-shoes landing page as its target.
templates.title: Write a content brief for 'best trail running shoes for monsoon'

acceptance_criteria: A link plan is saved whose target set is exactly the computed orphan set (non-root pages with zero inbound internal links)
Every page referenced by the plan exists in the seeded site and no planned link points a page at itself
templates.brief: Compute the site's orphan pages (non-root pages with zero inbound internal links) from the link graph and save an internal-link fix plan that links every orphan from the home page, using each orphan's H1 as the anchor text. The plan is a record; the site's links do not change.
templates.title: Internal-link fix plan for orphan pages
